controlTouch.$description: Minimum control height with touch input; the style preset sets it (Apple 44 pt, Material 40 dp).

fieldTouch.$description: Minimum text field and select height with touch input (Material 56 dp).

prominentTouch.$description: Height of a full-width primary button with touch input (iOS 50 pt).

field.$description: Resolved text field height: size.control, raised to size.fieldTouch with touch input.

iconStroke.$description: Icon stroke in screen pixels at every icon size (Lucide absolute stroke).

formWidth.$description: Readable width of a form page (sign-in, onboarding step); KPage(width: form).

maxWidth.$description: Maximum user-bubble width as a fraction of the conversation column (0–1); multiply by the available column width on Web and Flutter.

headerHeight.$description: Minimum card-header height; content and text scaling may increase the height.

height.$description: Minimum attachment-chip height; content and text scaling may increase the height.

headerHeight.$description: Minimum code-header height; content and text scaling may increase the height.

rowHeight.$description: Minimum detail-panel row height; content and text scaling may increase the height.
Minimum home-list row height; content and text scaling may increase the height.

compactHeight.$description: Compact Cartesian plot height for dashboard summaries; the standard chart height is unchanged.

mediaSize.$description: Leading media tile of a list row (icon on a tonal tile); the row centres on it.

height.$description: Extended floating action button that carries a page's primary action (Material 3).
Bar that appears over scrolled content on phones (iOS 44 pt navigation bar, Material 64 dp top app bar), below the status bar.

indicatorWidth.$description: Material 3 navigation bar: pill behind the selected icon.

width.$description: Animated KCard border (KCard border effect). Each effect conveys a state; apps may override color, colors and duration per card.
Swipe actions on KListItem: button width (Apple style), reveal and full-swipe thresholds as fractions of the row width.
KSettingsDialog (Decision 0017): dialog size on tablet and desktop, width of the section navigation and the content padding. Phones show a bottom sheet with a section list.

tileWidth.$description: KAvatarPicker: width of a shape tile and size of a colour swatch.

paddingBlockStart.$description: Page start inset, independent of the wider horizontal gutters on tablets and desktops. Safe-area insets are added by the component.

icon.$description: Text-adjacent icons grow with the text up to this factor (Decision 0015).
